meta.summary: Cellpose 4.2.1.1 CPU runtime with CLI, training, distributed and BioImage.IO extras, pinned DINOv3 integration, and browser-accessible official Qt GUI.
meta.description: Cellpose 4.2.1.1 CPU runtime with CLI, training, distributed and BioImage.IO extras, pinned DINOv3 integration, and browser-accessible official Qt GUI.

test: python -m pip check && python /opt/cellpose/share/testdata/cellpose_smoke.py identity | grep -Fx 'cellpose=4.2.1.1' >/dev/null && cellpose --version | grep -E '^cellpose version:[[:space:]]+4\.2\.1\.1[[:space:]]*$' >/dev/null && cellpose --help | grep -F 'Cellpose Command Line Parameters' >/dev/null && cellpose-gui --help | grep -F 'official Cellpose Qt GUI through noVNC' >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'wheel_sha256=6c5c5159fd459115bee390ffb01d94d5e1006b97c211bf3c1a7b37d5395a1a13' /opt/cellpose/share/doc/cellpose/SOURCE >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'dinov3_source_sha256=c990614a09f0d2021a40f535e0f645d058b5c7be00cf3498fe04d58f16fa93c3' /opt/cellpose/share/doc/cellpose/SOURCE >/dev/null && grep -Fx 'constraints_sha256=b99baa34115d8761adce6dba2fdefc393903b4707f785b02a969e7695a889406' /opt/cellpose/share/doc/cellpose/SOURCE >/dev/null

tmp=/tmp/taf-cellpose-core-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; python /opt/cellpose/share/testdata/cellpose_smoke.py core "$tmp" && test -s "$tmp/core.json" && grep -F '"mask_count": 2' "$tmp/core.json" >/dev/null && test -s "$tmp/synthetic_cp_masks.png" && rm -rf "$tmp"
tmp=/tmp/taf-cellpose-distributed-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; python /opt/cellpose/share/testdata/cellpose_smoke.py distributed "$tmp/data.zarr" && test -d "$tmp/data.zarr" && rm -rf "$tmp"
tmp=/tmp/taf-cellpose-formats-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; python /opt/cellpose/share/testdata/cellpose_smoke.py formats "$tmp" && test -s "$tmp/volume.nrrd" && test -s "$tmp/volume.tif" && rm -rf "$tmp"

tmp=/tmp/taf-cellpose-gui-export-$$; rm -rf "$tmp"; xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1440x1000x24' python /opt/cellpose/share/testdata/cellpose_smoke.py gui-export "$tmp" && test -s "$tmp/cellpose-gui.png" && test "$(wc -c < "$tmp/cellpose-gui.png")" -gt 10000 && test -s "$tmp/gui-image_cp_masks.png" && test -s "$tmp/gui-image_seg.npy" && rm -rf "$tmp"

upstream.name: Cellpose
upstream.citation: Pachitariu, Rariden, and Stringer. Cellpose-SAM: superhuman generalization for cellular segmentation. bioRxiv (2025).
